say:1:1330271001:1.text: Really? You have a heart of gold!

say:2:1330271002:1.text: Speaking of the princess... she used to buy all my floral wreaths just so I could play with her.
say:2:1330271002:1.source_cn: 忽然想起来……亚莲娜公主也经常买下所有的花环，那样我就...

say:3:1330271003:1.text: I miss her so much... May her soul rest in peace.
say:3:1330271003:1.source_cn: 我好想念亚莲娜公主，愿她的灵魂得到安息。
